c3f403d1701696ad.description: About the Role Saudi Consulting Services (Saudconsult) is seeking an experienced Civil CAD Draftsman to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves preparing accurate design and shop drawings for various civil infrastructure projects, utilizing advanced CAD software. Role Overview As a Civil CAD Draftsman, you will collaborate closely with civil and highway engineers. Your primary responsibility will be to translate designs, sketches, and field survey data into precise technical drawings. This role requires adherence to approved specifications and relevant authority requirements for all project documentation. Key Responsibilities Prepare design and shop drawings for roads and infrastructure projects using AutoCAD and Civil 3D. Draft plans, profiles, and cross sections for roads and intersections. Develop drawings for water, sewer, and storm drainage networks, including manholes and pavement details. Convert field surveys and preliminary sketches into accurate digital drawings. Coordinate utility drawings and identify potential clashes. Prepare As-Built drawings based on site data collected after project execution. Revise and update drawings in response to feedback from engineers, consultants, and clients. Extract preliminary quantities from drawings as required for project estimation. Ensure all work complies with approved standards and government authority requirements. Organize and archive drawings and files in accordance with the established document control system. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience as a Civil CAD Draftsman. A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in civil drafting. Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil 3D is essential. Strong understanding of civil engineering drafting principles and practices. Required Skills Ability to interpret engineering designs, sketches, and survey data accurately. Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality, precise drawings. Effective communication skills for collaborating with engineers and project stakeholders. Organizational skills for managing and archiving project documentation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where you will contribute to significant infrastructure projects within a professional consulting environment.

c3e2e3ee47d4b5ea.description: About Leap29 Leap29 is a global recruitment partner based in the UK, with over 25 years of international experience, including more than 6 years of operations in Saudi Arabia. The company is expanding its Workforce Management team in Saudi Arabia and is seeking an HR & Workforce Operations Specialist to support its contractor and employee workforce across the Kingdom. The Role The HR & Workforce Operations Specialist will ensure a smooth and compliant workforce experience, covering onboarding, documentation, payroll coordination, employee support, and daily workforce administration. This full-time role is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, and requires 1-5 years of experience. The salary range for this position is SAR 5,000-6,500 per month. Key Responsibilities Maintain accurate and confidential employee records. Collect and verify onboarding documents. Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding processes. Prepare HR letters, forms, contracts, and supporting documents. Support processes through platforms such as Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and Mudad. Track expiry dates for Iqama, work permits, passports, contracts, and insurance. Coordinate medical examinations and medical insurance. Respond to employee enquiries and support employee-relations matters. Collect and verify timesheets and payroll information. Follow up with employees, clients, internal teams, and service providers. Maintain employee, payroll, and operational trackers. Assist the Country Manager with reports, meetings, follow-ups, and task management. Escalate additional HR or operational duties as required. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will serve as a central point of contact for employees, contractors, clients, and internal stakeholders, ensuring efficient workforce processes, accurate records, and comprehensive support. This role requires collaboration with the Country Manager and operational teams to maintain high standards of service, compliance, and workforce engagement within a fast-paced business environment. Qualifications and Requirements 1-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Previous experience in recruitment, manpower supply, outsourcing, or workforce management companies is an advantage. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and growing business. Location This position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia.

c3eecf74b4b22a6f.description: About the Role Global Blue by Shift4 is seeking a Customer Service Representative to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on providing customer support in foreign languages, adhering to company standards and key performance indicators (KPIs). Role Overview The Customer Service Representative will be an integral part of the Customer Service Team, responsible for addressing customer inquiries with a strong focus on quality and performance. The role requires maintaining defined service level agreements (SLAs) and ensuring accurate information delivery. Key Responsibilities Communicate with customers in writing and via phone, adhering to defined SLA and quality standards. Maintain detailed records of customer interactions and contacts. Research necessary information using internal systems and available resources. Coordinate and communicate effectively with CS Team members, internal departments, and Global Blue offices. Follow up on customer inquiries that require additional resolution time. Identify and escalate priority issues as needed. Recommend improvements for existing processes. Accountabilities Provide customers with correct and complete information. Ensure the consistent maintenance of KPIs and SLAs. Verify that contact logging software is used correctly to facilitate accurate reports and analysis. Adhere to internal company rules and guidelines. Experience and Work Type Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in customer service. This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Information The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Duties and responsibilities may be subject to change upon arrangement.

c347a14bb7e35d57.description: Overview of the Role IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Guest Service Agent to join the team in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based at the First Vignette Collection in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Carlton Al Moaibed Hotel). The role serves as the initial point of contact for guests, focusing on delivering personalized experiences in luxury hospitality. Key Responsibilities Manage guest check-in and check-out processes efficiently, ensuring accuracy and a smooth experience. Welcome guests, anticipate their needs, and respond promptly to inquiries, requests, and concerns, escalating issues as necessary. Provide comprehensive information on hotel services, facilities, local attractions, and dining options. Process payments, post charges, prepare folios, and handle currency exchange in accordance with hotel financial procedures. Maintain clear communication with other departments such as Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, and Maintenance to fulfill guest requests. Operate the hotel switchboard, directing calls, taking messages, and managing wake-up call requests professionally. Adhere to all safety and security procedures to ensure a safe environment for guests and colleagues. Candidate Requirements This position is open to Saudi Nationals. Experience required: 0-1 years in a relevant field. Demonstrated passion for customer service and creating positive guest experiences. Ability to work in a dynamic team environment. About IHG Hotels & Resorts IHG Hotels & Resorts is committed to fostering inclusive teams and welcoming diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. The company provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. IHG supports employee wellbeing through its my Wellbeing framework, which focuses on health, lifestyle, and workplace support.

c3890e77a7a0c933.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Construction Manager Electrical BESS to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the Construction Manager in the execution of all electrical construction activities for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. The successful candidate will ensure that all work is completed safely, on time, to quality standards, and in compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and project schedules. Key Responsibilities Manage and coordinate electrical installation activities for BESS, MV/LV systems, transformers, PCS/inverters, switchgear, cables, earthing, and auxiliary systems. Plan and monitor daily and weekly construction activities against the approved project schedule. Coordinate with Civil, Mechanical, Engineering, QA/QC, HSE, Procurement, T&C, and subcontractor teams. Supervise subcontractors and monitor manpower, materials, equipment, and productivity on site. Ensure that all installations comply with approved drawings, specifications, applicable standards, and client requirements. Review method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and risk assessments for electrical works. Coordinate inspections, testing, Non-Conformance Report (NCR) resolution, and punch-point closure with the QA/QC team. Coordinate with vendors for equipment installation, inspection, testing, and technical support. Support pre-commissioning, commissioning, and energization activities for electrical systems. Monitor project progress, identify constraints or delays, and implement corrective actions as needed. Coordinate with the client and consultant for inspections, approvals, and resolution of technical issues. Maintain comprehensive progress reports, site records, and as-built documentation. Ensure strict compliance with Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements and electrical safety procedures. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in electrical construction management, particularly within BESS projects. Demonstrated ability to manage and coordinate complex electrical installations. Strong understanding of electrical systems, including MV/LV, transformers, PCS/inverters, and switchgear. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working on site to oversee construction activities. The role requires collaboration with various internal and external teams to ensure project success.

c32e33620649beb4.description: نبحث عن سكرتيرة منظمة وذات كفاءة للانضمام إلى فريقنا. ستكون مسؤولة عن إدارة المواعيد، تنظيم المستندات، وتقديم الدعم الإداري الشامل. مهام الوظيفة: * استقبال وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية والبريد الإلكتروني. * جدولة الاجتماعات والمواعيد وتنسيقها. * تنظيم وحفظ الملفات والمستندات بكفاءة. * تقديم الدعم المكتبي واللوجستي للإدارة. * إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية عند الحاجة.

c3cd9f3ff71c44ab.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الراجح الحديثة للمقاولات عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بمحاسبة التكاليف وحفظها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط ودراسة الأساليب المستخدمة في حساب التكلفة وتحديد عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة وحساب التكلفة الإجمالية. تحليل عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة بشكل دوري، وتحديد معدل التكلفة المعيارية، وتحديد الانحرافات ومساهمة كل منها في زيادة أو تقليل التكلفة. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالتكاليف وطرق التسعير، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة للإدارة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات حساب التكاليف ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في مجال المحاسبة وحساب التكلفة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بحساب التكاليف، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال محاسبة التكاليف. القدرة على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية وحفظها. بيئة العمل يعمل محاسب التكاليف بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الراجح الحديثة للمقاولات في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة لضمان دقة وفعالية العمليات المحاسبية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الراتب: غير معلن التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

c3f4efe47e254170.description: About the Role Zahid Tractor is seeking a Technician-CMD to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves the maintenance of equipment sold and serviced by the company. The Technician will report directly to the Service Supervisor or Branch Manager. Role Overview The Technician-CMD is responsible for the safe and efficient disassembly and assembly of machine, engine, and marine components, adhering to appropriate service literature. Key duties include performing pre-delivery inspections (PDI) and Technical Analysis Level 1 (TA1) on Caterpillar equipment, and installing attachments. Key Responsibilities Complete work assignments according to established time requirement guidelines. Remove, install, disassemble, and assemble various components, including fuel systems, turbochargers, water pumps, air compressors, hydraulic pumps, hydraulic cylinders, engines, transmissions, and torque converters, following service literature. Perform pre-delivery inspections (PDI) and Technical Analysis Level 1 (TA1) safely and efficiently. Install attachments sold and serviced by the company. Comply with routine reporting requirements by completing necessary paperwork such as work orders, warranty documentation, and equipment time tracking. Maintain communication with the branch supervisor or shop managers regarding assigned work orders and pertinent details. Conduct safety assessments before and during jobs, organize workstations, and address unsafe conditions. Collaborate effectively with other company personnel and execute instructions accurately. Provide assistance to other department personnel as needed. Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Service Supervisor or Manager, potentially specializing in specific areas. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Proven ability to meet the requirements of a Technician Trainee/Talent Pool. Capability to work effectively with minimal supervision. Required Skills Proficiency in disassembling and assembling machine/engine/marine components. Strong understanding of service literature and technical guidelines. Ability to perform pre-delivery inspections and Technical Analysis Level 1. Adherence to safety protocols and procedures. Effective communication and teamwork skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the Technician will work within a team environment, collaborating with supervisors and other personnel to ensure efficient service delivery.

c31147687bac9948.description: Key Job Responsibilities: QC Testing: Conduct comprehensive testing and troubleshooting of LV/MV switchgears, Control gears, Motor Starters, advanced relay testing, and programming, wiring diagram reading / modification / red-markup, control system trouble shooting, protection scheme verifications & modification and FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) management. Technical Leadership: Mentor and guide junior engineers / technicians, ensuring adherence to best practices in testing processes. c33d8bb4af4e9c1d.description: The Internal Auditor - Operations performs independent, risk-based operational audits across the organization in alignment with the Internal Audit Charter, methodology, and IIA Standards (IPPF). The role assesses governance, risk management, internal controls, and policy/regulatory compliance across end-to-end operational activities (hubs, logistics, fleet, gateways, customer service, cash/COD, and technology systems). Responsibilities Audit Planning & Preparation: Research operational areas, map process flows/risks, participate in pre-audit meetings, draft risk-and-control matrices, and establish sampling strategies. Shipment & Process Assurance: Audit full end-to-end logistics processes (booking, sorting, linehaul, delivery, POD, returns) and evaluate custody, scan sequence, timestamps, and seal controls. Cost, Productivity & Asset Reviews: Assess operational efficiency drivers (manpower, route/vehicle utilization, fleet maintenance, facility costs) and evaluate vendor/outsourced courier compliance against contracts and SLAs. Cash, COD & Revenue Controls: Test courier debriefs, COD collection/reconciliation, billing accuracy, and system inputs to prevent revenue leakage, loss, or unsupported write-offs. Data Analytics & Systems Assurance: Use Excel, Power BI, or analytical software to test 100% data populations, detect anomalies/overrides, and verify core operational system integrity. Safety, Security & Compliance: Review facility/fleet security, CCTV, safety protocols, regulatory permits, and incident escalations. Testing & Documentation: Execute testing, maintain evidence-backed working papers, and expand sample sizes when control failures are detected. Reporting & Recommendations: Draft clear audit observations, establish root causes, assign risk ratings, and propose practical corrective action plans. Action Follow-Up: Verify and test management closure evidence before signing off on resolved findings. Key Role Boundaries & Escalation Independence: Must remain objective and disclose any conflicts of interest or past operational roles immediately. Immediate Escalation: Suspected fraud, theft, deliberate control bypass, major shipment/cash loss, or severe safety/regulatory breaches must be escalated immediately. Formal Investigations: The auditor must not conduct formal fraud/misconduct investigations unless explicitly assigned under the formal investigation procedure. Decision Rights Category Scope May Decide Day-to-day audit execution, sample selection, evidence requests, routine walkthrough scheduling, and initial working paper drafts. May Recommend Scope expansion, control improvements, finding risk ratings, procedure changes, and fraud referrals. Requires Approval Audit scope/objective changes, final audit reports/ratings, external disclosures, and formal finding closures. Must Not Decide Operational policies, process ownership, control design/operation, risk acceptance, vendor selection, or disciplinary actions. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Audit Delivery (20%): Complete ≥95% of assigned audit tasks and milestones by scheduled target dates. Working-Paper Quality (15%): Achieve ≥95% compliance with audit documentation standards. Finding Evidence (15%): 100% of reported observations backed by traceable, verified evidence. Reporting Timeliness (15%): Draft observations submitted within agreed engagement deadlines. Critical Escalation (10%): Escalate 100% of validated critical risks/fraud indicators within 1 working day. Follow-Up Verification (10%): Complete ≥95% of assigned management action verifications on schedule. Data Analytics Usage (10%): Apply analytics/data testing in ≥80% of audits with available data. Professional Development (5%): Complete minimum 40 hours of relevant training annually. Bachelor’s degree in Internal Auditing, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or Engineering. Certifications: CIA (or in-progress), CFE, CRMA, CPA/ACCA, or ISO Lead Auditor preferred. Experience: Minimum 3+ years in internal audit, operational audit, risk, or compliance. Experience in logistics, transport, supply chain, or e-commerce is strongly preferred. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel; experience with Power BI, SQL, or audit management software is an advantage. Key Competencies: Professional scepticism, evidence-based judgment, root-cause analysis, concise report writing, and stakeholder communication.

c341bf0edb76475b.description: The UI/UX Specialist is responsible for shaping, designing, and continuously improving user experiences across KAUST’s IT services and touch points. Attention to detail with a focus on producing high-quality, consistent, and accessible designs.
